name: com.titanpestpro/public-tools
title: Titan Pest Pro
description: Pest control facts by ZIP, price ranges and contact, plus free inspection and callback requests.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the pest control services Titan Pest Pro offers in its Kansas City and Springfield service areas, the services it does not offer, and the published price range for each plan that has one. Prices are ranges; the exact price is confirmed at a free inspection. Optional input: category (plans, other, not_offered or all; default all). Returns a text summary and structured items with id, name and line. Does not book anything or check an address.

category.description: Which group to return. Default all.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Checks one 5-digit US ZIP code against Titan Pest Pro's service-area list (154 ZIP codes in the Kansas City and Springfield areas of Missouri and Kansas). Returns served true or false and, when served, the town, the market, the local location that covers it and that location's web page. Does not check dates or appointment openings.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property, for example 65807.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Returns how to reach Titan Pest Pro: the phone number, how calls and callbacks work, and the web page for requesting a free inspection. Takes no input.

tools.name: get_trust_facts
tools.description: Returns Titan Pest Pro's published facts about itself: founding year, licence numbers and the licence holder, BBB rating, Google review rating and review counts per market, and the approved wording of its Free Re-Service Guarantee. Every value is the exact published one. Takes no input.

tools.name: explain_free_inspection
tools.description: Explains Titan Pest Pro's free, no-obligation inspection: what happens, what it costs (nothing), which jobs are not free inspections (real-estate WDI/NPMA-33 inspections and dead animal removal), typical scheduling, the arrival call, and how to request one. Takes no input.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Lists Titan Pest Pro's own blog posts about pests and pest control, from a checked list (no guest or partner content). Optional query matches words in the post title; optional limit (1-20, default 10) and offset page through results. Returns post id, title, link and publish date, newest first; read_blog_post returns a post's text.

query.description: Words to match in post titles, for example mice or termites. Optional.

limit.description: How many posts to return. Default 10.

offset.description: How many matching posts to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: request_free_inspection
tools.description: Sends a free inspection request to Titan Pest Pro's team, the same request the titanpestpro.com/free-inspection/ form sends. Needs the person's phone number, the property's 5-digit ZIP code, what they need help with, how urgent it is, and their permission to send; name and email are optional. Sends nothing for a ZIP outside the service area. Not for real-estate WDI letters or dead animal removal. Returns a short status message.

phone.description: The user's 10-digit US phone number (digits, with or without dashes, dots, spaces, parentheses or a leading +1).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the property to be inspected.

need.description: What the user needs help with.

urgency.description: How urgent the user says it is.

name.description: The user's name, if they gave it. Optional.

email.description: The user's email, if they gave it. Optional.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Asks Titan Pest Pro's team to call the person back; a team member calls back during regular hours. Needs the person's 10-digit US phone number, a short reason and their permission to send; name is optional. Does not book a visit or look up any account. Phones at (888) 343-9939 are answered around the clock. Returns a short status message.

phone.description: The user's 10-digit US phone number (digits, with or without dashes, dots, spaces, parentheses or a leading +1).

reason.description: In the user's words, briefly what the call is about (for example, ants in the kitchen). Plain text, up to 300 characters.

name.description: The user's name, if they gave it. Optional.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Searches a saved copy of Titan Pest Pro's website pages by keyword: service, plan, location and market pages, checked blog posts, and the Pest Guides. Returns up to 10 matches, each with a page id, title, link, a short snippet and a source field: titan for Titan's own pages, guide for the Pest Guides content. The source filter narrows the search to one of the two. No match returns an empty list.

query.description: Words to look for, for example termites Olathe or mosquito plan.

source.description: titan = Titan's own pages and posts, guide = the Pest Guides content, all = both. Default all.

limit.description: How many matches to return. Default 5.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Returns the saved plain text of one Titan Pest Pro website page, by the page id from search_site or get_site_map, with its title, link and source (titan for Titan's own pages, guide for the Pest Guides content). Long pages are shortened and say so; the link has the full page. Phone numbers other than Titan's line, hours and dollar figures are left out; prices are ranges, confirmed at a free inspection. An unknown id returns an error.

id.description: The page id from search_site or get_site_map, for example pest-control-olathe-ks.

tools.name: get_site_map
tools.description: Returns the structure of Titan Pest Pro's website as titled links in groups: the 2 markets (Springfield and Kansas City), the 12 location pages, the plan and service pages from the main menu, the key pages (free inspection, contact, about, privacy policy) and the files written for AI agents (pricing.md with the published price ranges, llms.txt). Each link carries the page id read_page accepts when the page is in the saved copy.

tools.name: ask_titan
tools.description: Answers one question about Titan Pest Pro's services, plans, process or policies with the company's approved answer, word for word, from its checked Knowledge Catalog. Read-only. When no approved answer matches, it says so and points to get_contact or request_callback; it never writes a new answer. Any price is a range confirmed at the free inspection.

question.description: The customer's question in plain words, for example: Do you treat for termites?
